about.therapist_cert: Cert. ISMET - Instituto Superior de Medicinas Tradicionales
about.approach_quote:
With a degree in cognitive behavioral psychology and a deep curiosity about how people think and act, I found myself working in marketing and data analysis, exploring behavior and trends.

At the same time, I kept nurturing my true passion—movement, balance, and energy. Inspired by martial arts and Eastern healing traditions, my focus naturally shifted. Since 2020, I've been dedicated to foot reflexology, Qi Gong, Yoga and subtle energy work, helping people restore harmony and well-being in a gentle, natural way.

balance_reflexology.title: Balance Reflexology Massage
balance_reflexology.description:
"A restorative reflexology experience designed to calm the nervous system, center the mind, and reconnect you with your natural state of balance."

The session begins with conscious pressure on key foot reflex zones, helping to harmonize energy flow through the body's main meridians. As tension softens, precise reflexology techniques support the release of energetic blockages and reinforce internal stability.

Natural oils and grounding touch encourage deep presence, helping you feel centered, lighter, and rebalanced from within. Ideal for anyone seeking renewal, emotional clarity, and a profound sense of calm after periods of stress or imbalance.

signature_reflexology.title: Signature Reflexology Massage
signature_reflexology.description:
"This powerful reflexology treatment is for people living with chronic pain, long‑term discomfort or diagnosed conditions who want a focused, therapeutic approach to their health, not just a relaxing massage."

First, we move through the "3 Ways of Purification", awakening key reflex points and meridians in the feet to stimulate the body's natural detox pathways and encourage a general cleansing from within.

Then, a deep and intense reflexology phase works directly on points linked to your specific issues, using strong pressure to meet the pain and create space for release. This unique combination promotes profound healing and a grounded sense of relaxation, helping to correct underlying imbalances and support your overall well‑being.

executive_detox.title: Executive Detox Massage
executive_detox.description:
"A massage that combines inner cleansing through foot reflex points to restore balance and well-being."

We begin with a gentle warm-up using a natural oil to relax the feet and prepare them for deeper work. The session then transitions into a special ritual called "The 3 Ways of Purification", designed to support your body's natural cleansing processes. By stimulating specific reflex points, we encourage the elimination of toxins through the digestive, reproductive, and lymphatic systems, promoting a sense of lightness and inner balance.

athlete_recovery.title: Athlete Recovery Reflexology & Leg Release
athlete_recovery.description:
"A sport-focused recovery protocol combining deep leg release with targeted foot reflexology — designed to restore lightness, ease, and balance after training."

Built for bodies that work hard. We begin with decontracting work on calves and quadriceps, releasing the heaviness and tightness that build up in the legs after effort — whether from running, strength training, or long days on your feet.

Then the session moves to the feet: precise reflexology on the points most connected to your sport and your current condition, supporting circulation, recovery, and whole-body balance from the ground up.

Note: only offered as a complete sport-specific protocol.

pure_body_massage.title: Pure Body Massage
pure_body_massage.description:
"A refined full body massage designed to release accumulated tension through continuous, flowing and involving touch."

A pure massage experience focused on depth, presence, and profound relaxation — with no reflexology and no added ritual, only the quality of the manual work itself. Slow, enveloping strokes travel through shoulders, back, and limbs, helping the body soften, unwind, and settle into a state of profound ease.

An introduction to my signature touch at Signature Healing Touch — ideal for those who want to experience the essence of the work before exploring the longer ritual journeys.

signature_full_body_ritual.title: Signature Full Body Ritual Experience
signature_full_body_ritual.description:
"A two-hour ritual uniting full-body massage and deep foot reflexology — a slow-motion escape designed to release tension, quiet the mind, and restore inner balance."

A warm, flowing full-body massage melts tension from shoulders, back and legs, while deep foot reflexology gently rebalances your inner landscape.

Soft towels wrap you in heat, the air carries a light hint of essential oils, and your breath begins to deepen without effort. With two steady hands, the massage travels from shoulders to lower back and out toward every limb, using a touch that is both gentle and firm to soften knots, clear hidden blocks, and help your muscles remember how to move with ease again.

Then the focus drops to your feet: precise reflexology points are held and released, sending gentle waves through the whole body and helping your nervous system switch from alert to calm. Time stretches. Thoughts quiet. You feel heavy and safe on the table, as if the ground is holding you from beneath.

This experience is designed to leave you lighter, quieter inside, and deeply at peace: like waking up after a long, restorative sleep, but fully aware and present.

A signature experience for this exact moment in your life.
